description: 成长账本：用记账的方式管理自我成长与奖励兑换

scripts.copy-wasm: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const cands=['node_modules/jeep-sqlite/node_modules/sql.js/dist/sql-wasm.wasm','node_modules/sql.js/dist/sql-wasm.wasm'];const src=cands.find(p=>fs.existsSync(p));if(!src){console.error('找不到 sql-wasm.wasm，候选路径：'+cands.join(', '));process.exit(1)}fs.mkdirSync('public/assets',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,'public/assets/sql-wasm.wasm');console.log('wasm <- '+src)"
